content: Dhruv asked Sunita to discuss options for his expired auto policy, expressing confusion. Sunita explained the policy expired on March 8, the reinstatement fee is $50 with a 10% premium penalty for the first month, and offered to waive the penalty if he switches to a new plan. Dhruv requested quotes for new plans and asked for the deadline to reinstate his current policy.

action_items: Sunita to send quotes for new auto insurance plans
Sunita to provide the deadline for reinstating the old policy
